Technical manual

Run the dashboard, trace a question to its source, and verify a release. Commands start in the root of the FIRST FIRE repository.

Choose a runtime

Public or offlineOpen the public dashboard or double-click dist/index.html after downloading the repository. The browser handles case questions, search, archive chat, and the FM² forecast. To serve the same files locally, use the command below and open port 8000.
Local modelInstall Python 3.12 and Ollama. Start Ollama, then run the setup and server commands below. The initial setup downloads weights. Open http://127.0.0.1:8765/#chat. On Windows use .chat-venv\Scripts\python.exe for the server.
# Static dashboard
python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist

# Local transformer chat (macOS or Linux)
python3.12 scripts/setup_chat.py
.chat-venv/bin/python -m chat.server

Trace a question through the system

Case questionsIn Evidence comparison → Ask your own question, type a question and select Find evidence. site/case-questions.js compares its terms with the open case’s passages, limits and comparisons. Results include source links. For SAME, try “Did the detector miss Teflon smoke?” Asking for exact seconds to alarm exposes a measurement gap: the recorded duration refers to smoke generation.
Find evidencesite/search.js combines a bundled Model2Vec embedding with keyword matching across case and investigation summaries. Exact test IDs and individual measurement rows are available in Data explorer.
Research chatThe public chat retrieves from the bundled archive. On the local service, BGE embeddings, BM25 keyword scores and run IDs retrieve evidence. Qwen3 0.6B selects up to three passages via Ollama. The server validates selections and returns their text and citations. Documented Apollo incidents use a dedicated sourced lookup.

Inspect the local API

curl http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/health
curl -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"message":"Did the Nomex ignite in sample 2-7?"}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/chat

Health reports readiness, model identity and fingerprints. Chat accepts a 1–2,000 character message and up to 12 prior messages. Inspect status, answer and each citation’s url and locator.

FIRST FIRE · Maintenance

Data and release operations

Edit the source directories, rebuild the distribution, and check the packaged site before publishing.

Know what each result represents

NASA observationsdata/raw/ holds 20 original experimental tables. The catalog describes 19 investigations. Nine contribute the 1,058 normalized observations in data/tests.csv. Resolve a value using its original filename, row, units and DOI. A blank value means the field cannot be used as a measurement.
Habitat rankingThe explorer filters by subject and optional material. Within each investigation it selects the best eligible row. More complete gravity, ambient oxygen and pressure records rank first, then smaller weighted distance. Inverse burner oxygen is excluded from cabin comparisons. All ranked gravity values represent nominal orbit.
FM² forecastA shared uncertain oxygen threshold supplies probabilities for four planned burns at 8.2 psia. The default mean is 26% oxygen and its standard deviation is 1.5 percentage points. Scores use only resolved entries. The values are illustrative. No verified lunar burn outcomes are recorded in this release.

Change and verify the archive

Edit interface code in site/, case content in data/cases.json, and local chat code in chat/. After changing a scientific claim, verify its source locator and the experimental conditions. Use Python 3.10+ to build, and Node 18+ for the case-question tests.

python3 scripts/build.py
python3 scripts/verify_release.py
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'
node --test tests/case-questions.test.cjs

The build regenerates records and the forecast, checks quotations, and assembles dist/. Release verification checks file hashes, source-table hashes, row counts, asset links and exclusion of the assessor key. Publish the complete dist/ from the verified Git commit. Open a case and a PDF in a signed-out browser after deployment.

Interpret the benchmark

Local chat v2.1 passed 78 of 100 questions under the full scoring rubric and 14 of 24 on a separate set. The 100-question check grades content, response status and required citations. Compare individual replies and failures in the benchmark. These runs evaluate local chat. The case-question matcher has its own tests. A blind comparison with human researchers is available as a protocol.

Diagnose common failures

Missing data or blank dashboard: open dist/index.html with its adjacent files, or rebuild. Local model unavailable: run ollama list, confirm qwen3:0.6b is installed, and check /api/health. Unexpected evidence: check the material, endpoint, oxygen field and test ID in the original row before using the result.
